fields.FIR_Description: A oral complaint dated 2026-03-27 states that the complainant was allegedly struck by a person after a verbal exchange at Kayal Colony Bus Stand Area in Tirunelveli and later sought medical attention, on 2026-03-26 at about 23:15. Meena Bai reported the matter orally at Tirunelveli Town PS; the contact number given was 9000000300. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. The complainant alleged that Anand Krishnan may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000088. The complainant mentioned physical documents and CCTV footage. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00096, as the mobile number 9000000088 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim allegedly struck after a verbal exchange in a public place.
fields.Keywords: assault, altercation, documents, CCTV, mobile number, bus stand, suspect, night
